content:
Daily scratchpad / quick todo (finance & legal)

Today: 2026-03-03
Context: quick personal notes while triaging outstanding vendor invoices and contract redlines. Not polished.

High priority
- [ ] INV-2026-021 (Vertex Analytics) -- amount $14,200 -- verify PO + coding in NetSuite. Contact: accounting@vertex (left voicemail). Due 2026-03-15. Follow-up: ask SRE billing owner to confirm usage lines by 2026-03-05. Linked docs: invoices/INV-2026-021.pdf
- [ ] Renewal reminder: DataClamp renewal notice received 2026-02-25. Auto-renew on 2026-04-01 unless we trigger non-renewal. Need legal redline review: see contract draft (CON-DC-2024). Assign: Priya to review T&Cs for data residency clause -- pinged in #legal-review yesterday.

Contracts / redlines
- Quick notes on DC contract: remove broad indemnity clause in section 6, propose mutual indemnity + cap tied to fees. Ask Priya for standard clause (legal library).
- Azure infra subcontract (SUB-AZ-99): waiting on counterparty markup -- check for both export control and confidentiality carve-outs. If no response by 2026-03-06 escalate to Head of Legal.

Invoicing backlog
- [ ] Batch check: Feb vendor run (9 invoices) -- 3 missing receipts -- flagged to ops. Keep a table later but quick plan: chase receipts first, then push to AP for payment.
- Manual credit memos: ACME overbilling claim -- open dispute ticket with AP (JIRA-FIN-452).

Reminders / calendar
- Call with SRE billing owner (Samir) -- 2026-03-04 10:00 PT -- agenda: invoice line items, usage spikes for INV-2026-021.
- Legal sync with Priya -- 2026-03-05 11:00 PT -- agenda: DataClamp renewal, standard redline language.

Random / notes to self
- Confirm whether we can delay DataClamp renewal 30 days without penalty (review clause 3.2).
- Check whether Dedicated/Private customer discounts apply to this vendor (note: procurement said maybe).
- Keep this doc minimal, move final notes to Confluence: CONFLUENCE-FT-7890 (vendor-management page).

Unresolved questions
- Do we have a PO for Vertex Analytics? I think PO-2026-08 exists but need confirmation from procurement.
- Who owns credit memos for ACME? Was it Sam or Olivia -- check slack thread #acct-payments.

Quick links / refs

- Jira: JIRA-FIN-452 (ACME dispute)
